description: This file defines the 'SerializableTypeDescription' class, which implements the 'ISerializableTypeDescription' interface. It models metadata about a type for serialization purposes within the Orleans framework, including details like accessibility, type parameters, serialization hooks, constructor analysis, and various flags related to serialization and instantiation behavior.

classes.name: SerializableTypeDescription
classes.description: Represents detailed metadata of a type for serialization, including its accessibility, base type, type parameters, members, and behaviors related to instantiation, copying, and serialization hooks within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: GetObjectCreationExpression
methods.description: Produces an expression syntax to instantiate the described type, either by default construction for value types or an uninitialized object for reference types.
